name: elevenlabs
summary: Successfully completed the ElevenLabs quickstart end-to-end. Installed the SDK (`pip install elevenlabs python-dotenv`), created the example script, and generated a valid MP3 audio file (`output.mp3`, 41KB, MPEG ADTS layer III, 128 kbps, 44.1 kHz, mono) from the text "The first move is what sets everything in motion." using voice ID JBFqnCBsd6RMkjVDRZzb and model eleven_v3.
deviations: The quickstart's final step calls `play(audio)` to play audio through speakers. Since the sandbox is headless with no audio output hardware, I adapted the script to save the returned audio stream to `output.mp3` instead. This is the only deviation; all other steps (SDK installation, API key usage via ELEVENLABS_API_KEY env var, code structure, voice/model/output_format parameters) followed the quickstart exactly.
